<description>
Expose individual functional tests through the same CTest interface used for unit tests, making them easier to select, inspect, and rerun from the command line or CTest-aware IDEs.

Scheduling unit and functional tests together may improve parallel execution. It also enables per-test results and timings to be uploaded to our [Bitcoin Core CDash instance](https://my.cdash.org/index.php?project=bitcoin-core), helping track failures and runtime changes across builds.

Registration is opt-in with `BUILD_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS=ON` and requires CMake 4.4 or newer. The existing runner remains available for RPC coverage and CSV results. The native macOS CI job exercises the combined CTest workflow and passes. See `test/README.md` for usage and limitations.
</description>
